envelope.description: Declare the failure, output-schema and conversion types

body.title: Declare the failure, output-schema and conversion types
body.summary: In src/daemon/tools/types.ts add ToolFailureKind (missing-tool, missing-signin, unreachable, timed-out, rejected, conversion-failed, schema-mismatch, denied), ToolDenialReason (declined, timed-out, no-client, and cancelled from AMD-5), ToolFailure { kind, message, original?, denial? }, the optional Tool.outputSchema (typebox TSchema), the optional ToolResult.failure, ConversionProviders { resolveProvider(role) } and the optional ToolDeps.conversion. All additions are optional so the four ToolDeps builders keep compiling.
acceptanceChecks: npm run build compiles with the four ToolDeps builders unchanged
ToolDenialReason has exactly the four values declined, timed-out, no-client and cancelled
no existing ToolResult or ToolDeps field changes meaning

tests.name: src/daemon/tools/__tests__/failure-types.test.ts: ToolDenialReason and ToolFailureKind hold exactly the declared values
